title: RefusalJsonOutput
description: What a refused `rwv <verb> --json` prints when the verb printed nothing before refusing: every repo it judged.

refused.description: Each repo the verb judged, with that state's choices.

Axis.description: What a refusal judged a repo on. Its token is the kind `rwv explain` serves; the order here is the order a repo's lines print in.

oneOf.description: Uncommitted work, or a VCS operation in progress, in a checkout.
Another checkout derives from what the verb would remove.
A branch and the branch it takes in from or publishes to.
A name the verb was given is unusable.
A project whose `rwv.toml` does not load.
The commit a lock pins for a member, and whether a ref reaches it.
A weave branch's record: how it is used and the branch it lands into.

id.description: The choice's id on the axis's page; null for one it does not number.

run.description: The commands, one per line, as the terminal prints them.

where.description: The directory it must run in; null where it runs here or names its own directory.

FactKind.description: A fact about a judged repo. Facts are reported; they never select a choice.

oneOf.description: A superseded tip was recorded for the branch.
The branch is an ancestor of where it lands.
Another project's live lock pins the commits.
Other live weave branches declare the branch.
The pin is on the branch it lands into.
The member was left detached because its branch is checked out elsewhere.
The unlanded commits carry changes equivalent to commits where they land.

JudgedOutput.description: One judged repo, as `--json` carries it.

axis.description: What it was judged on; `rwv explain <axis>` serves the axis's page.

choices.description: What this state can run, in the order the page lists it.

listed.description: The files, paths or commits the state lists.

path.description: The repo's path, `projects/<name>` for the project repo.

state.description: The state it was judged in, as that page names it.

subject.description: What the state names, when it names something.

workspace.description: The workspace the repo was judged in, when that is not the one the verb ran in.
